{"name": "Sun", "subtitle": "", "body": "Note: The Sun, our very own star, is a massive ball of hot plasma that sits at the center of our solar system.
It's the source of all life and energy on Earth, so I've colored it chlorophyll green in our plot!
* Type: A yellow dwarf star (G-type main-sequence star).
* Age: About 4.6 billion years old, and is expected to continue its current phase for about 5 billion years
more, then evolve into a Red Giant.
* Diameter: Roughly 1.4 million kilometers (865,000 miles), about 109 times the diameter of Earth.
* Mass: About 333,000 times the mass of Earth
* Composition: Primarily hydrogen (about 73%) and helium (about 25%), with trace amounts of other elements.
* Surface Temperature: 5778 K, around 5,500 degrees Celsius, or 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit
* Core Temperature: Around 15 million degrees Celsius (27 million degrees Fahrenheit)
* Stellar Class: Main-sequence. Stars in the prime of their lives, fusing hydrogen into helium in their cores.
* Absolute Magnitude: 4.83
* Spectral Type: G2V
* Object Type: Star
The Sun is composed of several layers:
* Core: The innermost region where nuclear fusion occurs, converting hydrogen into helium and releasing energy.
* Radiative Zone: Energy from the core travels outward through this zone via radiation.
* Convective Zone: Energy is transported through this zone via convection (the movement of hot plasma).
* Photosphere: The visible surface of the Sun.
* Chromosphere: A thin layer above the photosphere.
* Corona: The outermost layer, a very hot and tenuous plasma that extends millions of kilometers into space.
Standard for comparison to other stars:
* Luminosity: 1.000000 Lsun
* Mass: 1.00 Msun
* Distance: 0 pc (0 ly)
* Plotting marker size: 12 px"}
data.name: Sun
text:
Sun
Note: The Sun, our very own star, is a massive ball of hot plasma that sits at the center of our solar system.
It's the source of all life and energy on Earth, so I've colored it chlorophyll green in our plot!
* Type: A yellow dwarf star (G-type main-sequence star).
* Age: About 4.6 billion years old, and is expected to continue its current phase for about 5 billion years
more, then evolve into a Red Giant.
* Diameter: Roughly 1.4 million kilometers (865,000 miles), about 109 times the diameter of Earth.
* Mass: About 333,000 times the mass of Earth
* Composition: Primarily hydrogen (about 73%) and helium (about 25%), with trace amounts of other elements.
* Surface Temperature: 5778 K, around 5,500 degrees Celsius, or 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit
* Core Temperature: Around 15 million degrees Celsius (27 million degrees Fahrenheit)
* Stellar Class: Main-sequence. Stars in the prime of their lives, fusing hydrogen into helium in their cores.
* Absolute Magnitude: 4.83
* Spectral Type: G2V
* Object Type: Star
The Sun is composed of several layers:
* Core: The innermost region where nuclear fusion occurs, converting hydrogen into helium and releasing energy.
* Radiative Zone: Energy from the core travels outward through this zone via radiation.
* Convective Zone: Energy is transported through this zone via convection (the movement of hot plasma).
* Photosphere: The visible surface of the Sun.
* Chromosphere: A thin layer above the photosphere.
* Corona: The outermost layer, a very hot and tenuous plasma that extends millions of kilometers into space.
Standard for comparison to other stars:
* Luminosity: 1.000000 Lsun
* Mass: 1.00 Msun
* Distance: 0 pc (0 ly)
* Plotting marker size: 12 px
